# Jelajah

> A stamp rally on Bitcoin Cash. Pay a stall and its stamp NFT is minted in the same transaction. Burn stamps from 3 different stalls, and the rally's covenant pays you back and mints a trophy that works as a membership card.

Everything is on chain (CashScript covenants, CashTokens). There is no server and no database. Built for BCH BLAZE 2026.

## Links
- [Live app](https://jelajah-bch.vercel.app): the mainnet rally. Add `?net=chipnet` for the test rally.
- [Source code and README](https://github.com/PugarHuda/jelajah): contracts, threat model, test suite and transaction proofs.
- [Deck](https://jelajah-bch.vercel.app/deck.pdf)

## App routes
- `#/stats`: per-stall sales and top collectors, recomputed from covenant history.
- `#/organize`: open your own rally with a WizardConnect wallet. The rally is shared as a `?r=` link.
- `#/device/<stall id>`: a stall's phone that signs buyers' proof-of-presence codes.
- `#/reclaim`: the organizer takes back the leftover pool after the rally ends.
- `#/stall/<stall id>`: a printable stall poster with a QR code.
